name: Kölner Korpus des Kiezdeutschen / Cologne Corpus of Kiezdeutsch
attribution: Neubauer, Antonia Marie & Catasso, Nicholas (2025), Kölner Korpus des Kiezdeutschen / Cologne Corpus of Kiezdeutsch, Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15465769
redistribution_policy: CC BY 4.0; attribution required and transformations must be indicated. RhymeLab downloads only the transcription PDFs and stores derived register-attestation statistics locally.
speaker_population: 13 male vocational-school students; monolingual, multilingual and mixed peer groups

ingestion_policy.purpose: Register evidence for phrases already present in the RhymeLab phrase catalog; not general German commonness.
ingestion_policy.unit: conservative PDF transcript line after deterministic GAT2/header cleanup
notes: No phrase type is inferred from occurrence in this corpus.
Counts are treated as youth/urban/spoken register evidence, not population-representative frequency.
